name: Enfortumab vedotin ADC–payload exposure: exploratory reduced model
description: Exploratory one-compartment antibody decay coupled to one-compartment MMAE formation and elimination. This historical reduction lacks the DAR/FcRn, organ, transporter and enzyme structure of the Choules Simcyp PBPK model. Table constants and DDI proxy ratios are not simulation validation; calibrated curves do not reproduce the original mechanism.
